basic_details.job_title: DMHO Hanumakonda Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 51 Lab Technician, Staff Nurse and More Posts

application_fee.details: The application fee must be paid in the shape of a Demand Draft drawn in favour of DM&HO, Hanumakonda.

age_limit.details: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years in terms of Rule 12(1) (a) (V) of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules 1996. The minimum and maximum age shall be reckoned as on 01-07-2026.

(Epidemiology) with 2 years' experience in Public Health. | anm: Intermediate MPHW / MPHA 18 months Training Certificate Registered with respective councils TG State. | pharmacists: D.Pharm / B.Pharm / Pharm.D registered with Pharmacy council of Telangana. | 2nd anm: Intermediate MPHW / MPHA 18 months Training Certificate Registered with respective councils TG State. | psychiatrist: MD Psychiatrist Registered with TS Medical Council. | lab manager: MSc. (Micro Biology / Bio Chemistry) Registered with respective councils TG State.

selection_process: Selection will be done on Merit Basis and based on the following criteria: Total marks are 100
of which 90 marks will be allotted based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination
and 10 marks will be awarded for age. Weight-age for age will be reckoned from 18 years of age of the candidate
awarding 0.5 mark for one completed year of age with a maximum of 10 marks (reckoned as on 01-07-2026).
how_to_apply: Download the application form along with instructions from the official website of Hanumakonda District.
Fill in the application form completely with all required details.

Attach self-attested copies of all necessary certificates including S.C.S/Date of Birth certificate, intermediate/10+2 certificate, qualifying examination pass certificate and marks memos, registration certificates of respective councils, community/EWS/Ex-servicemen/NCC/PH certificates if applicable, and study certificates from 4th class to 10th class (or residence certificate from Tahsildar/MRO).
Enclose the Demand Draft for the application fee drawn in favour of DM&HO, Hanumakonda.
Submit the filled-in application form in person or through registered post to the District Medical & Health Officer, Hanumakonda District within the due date.
important_instructions: Applications received after due dates will be summarily rejected and the District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays. Selected candidates shall maintain the Headquarters and the positions are not transferable. The mode of appointment is on an outsourcing basis or contract basis for a period of 1 year or till actual need ceases, whichever is earlier. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending interviews. The posts notified are not permanent or regular Government posts and are purely temporary. The panel of candidates will be utilized for future vacancies until a period of one year from the final date of selection of candidates in this notification. Employment is subject to disciplinary and codal rules, and deviation will lead to termination.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Hanumakonda Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid in the shape of a Demand Draft drawn in favour of DM&HO, Hanumakonda.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Hanumakonda Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be done on Merit Basis and based on the following criteria: Total marks are 100, of which 90 marks will be allotted based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination, and 10 marks will be awarded for age. Weight-age for age will be reckoned from 18 years of age of the candidate, awarding 0.5 mark for one completed year of age with a maximum of 10 marks (reckoned as on 01-07-2026).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMHO Hanumakonda Recruitment
content_sections.text: Download the application form along with instructions from the official website of Hanumakonda District. Fill in the application form completely with all required details. Attach self-attested copies of all necessary certificates including S.C.S/Date of Birth certificate, intermediate/10+2 certificate, qualifying examination pass certificate and marks memos, registration certificates of respective councils, community/EWS/Ex-servicemen/NCC/PH certificates if applicable, and study certificates from 4th class to 10th class (or residence certificate from Tahsildar/MRO). Enclose the Demand Draft for the application fee drawn in favour of DM&HO, Hanumakonda. Submit the filled-in application form in person or through registered post to the District Medical & Health Officer, Hanumakonda District within the due date.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: S.S.C / Dated of Birth Certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks Memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration Certificates of respective Councils Latest Community Certificate / EWC Certificate / Ex-Servicemen / NCC / Physically Handicapped certificate (whichever applicable) Study certificate for the years from 4th class to 10th class (or residence certificate from Tahsildar/MRO) PH certificate (if claiming reservation under PH Quota) Relevant certificates for Ex-service Men Quota Registration Certificate from the concerned Medical Council / Nursing Council / Para Medical Board / Other relevant authority Photograph duly pasted on the application form

content_sections.heading: DMHO Hanumakonda Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after due dates will be summarily rejected and the District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays. Selected candidates shall maintain the Headquarters and the positions are not transferable. The mode of appointment is on an outsourcing basis or contract basis for a period of 1 year or till actual need ceases, whichever is earlier. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending interviews. The posts notified are not permanent or regular Government posts and are purely temporary. The panel of candidates will be utilized for future vacancies until a period of one year from the final date of selection of candidates in this notification. Employment is subject to disciplinary and codal rules, and deviation will lead to termination.

faq.question: Q1. What is DMHO Hanumakonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DMHO Hanumakonda Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by the District Medical and Health Officer Hanumakonda to fill 51 vacancies for various posts under NHM on a contract or outsourcing basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 51 vacancies are notified across various categories including Staff Nurse, Lab Technician, Medical Officer, Pediatrician, and Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DMHO Hanumakonda Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit filled-in applications is 15-10-2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01-07-2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for Others and Rs. 250/- for SC, ST, and PH candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of DM&HO, Hanumakonda.

faq.question: Q6. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: Selection is done on a merit basis based on total marks out of 100, where 90 marks are allotted based on qualifying examination marks and 10 marks are awarded for age weightage.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of submission of applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline either in person or through registered post to the District Medical & Health Officer Hanumakonda District.

faq.question: Q8. Are these permanent government posts?
faq.answer: No, these posts are not permanent or regular government posts and are purely temporary on a contract or outsourcing basis for 1 year or until the actual need ceases.
